page_title: BET 2-1 SEV | Betis v Sevilla 30/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+4' Saul Niguez (Sevilla) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Mateo Busquets had an easy-decision to make.
90+3' Having seen unsporting behavior, Mateo Busquets shows a yellow card to one of the players sitting on the bench. And Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta (Sevilla) is the recipient.

90+2' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) sends the ball into the penalty area from a free kick a few yards outside the box. The cross is good, but the goalkeeper shows himself in a good light as he leaps high to intercept the ball.
90+1' Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) sends in a lofted cross from a long-range free kick, but his poor effort goes out of play.
89' Handball by Cedric Bakambu (Betis).
87' The substitution has been made. Cedric Bakambu (Betis) has replaced Cucho Hernandez.
87' Manuel Pellegrini has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Sergi Altimira (Betis) replacing Pablo Fornals.
86' Loic Bade (Sevilla) goes into the book for a horrible tackle. A yellow card is necessary in this case.
85' It will be a substitution. Stanis Idumbo (Sevilla) is ready to enter the pitch as Albert Sambi Lokonga walks off.
85' Albert Sambi Lokonga (Sevilla) brings an opponent down and Mateo Busquets interrupts the game.
83' Saul Niguez (Sevilla) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
82' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) offside.
82' Johnny Cardoso (Betis) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle.
81' Saul Niguez (Sevilla) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Mateo Busquets stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
81' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla), is intercepted by the opposition's defence.
79' Peque (Sevilla) commits a minor foul to interrupt the attacking move of his opponent and is warned by the referee that he will get a yellow card if he does it again.
78' Peque (Sevilla) is penalised for holding. Mateo Busquets signals a set piece.
76' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta has decided to make a change. Peque (Sevilla) replaces Nemanja Gudelj.
76' Substitution. Chidera Ejuke (Sevilla) in, Ruben Vargas out.
76' That's unlucky! Cucho Hernandez (Betis) beautifully controls a pass and from the edge of the box drills a shot in on goal, but it's inadvertently blocked by a defender and cleared.
74' The fouls committed statistics – 7:16.
71' Manuel Pellegrini has decided to substitute Isco and he is replaced by Giovani Lo Celso (Betis).
70' Pablo Fornals (Betis) sprays a pass out to Aitor Ruibal, but he can't beat his man to get to the ball.
69' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Mateo Busquets no option but to blow his whistle.
66' That will be all from Jesus Rodriguez who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Aitor Ruibal (Betis).
66' Francisco Javier Garcia Pimienta prepares a substitution. Isaac Romero is replaced by Akor Adams (Sevilla).
66' A substitution has been made. Jose Angel Carmona is replaced by Saul Niguez (Sevilla).
65' Johnny Cardoso (Betis) finds himself unmarked on the edge of the box, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post.
65' Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) threads a pass through the eye of a needle into the box for Ruben Vargas, but Adrian displays great awareness to stop him.
63' Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
63' Jesus Rodriguez (Betis) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
62' Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
60' Adrian reacts well to deny a long-range free kick from Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) towards the left side of the goal.
59' Johnny Cardoso (Betis) holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows for a foul after seeing the whole situation.
57' Youssouf Sabaly (Betis) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Mateo Busquets blows his whistle for a foul.
56' Isco (Betis) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
56' Betis failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
56' Antony (Betis) controls the ball from the free kick on the edge of the box and releases a strike that could have ended up in the left side of the goal but for a magnificent save by Orjan Nyland.
55' Isco (Betis) tries to take the opposition by surprise with a quick free kick into the box.
55' Loic Bade (Sevilla) pulls the shirt of his opponent and only escapes without punishment due to the benevolence of the referee.
54' Kike Salas (Sevilla) is penalised for holding. Mateo Busquets signals a set piece.
53' Kike Salas (Sevilla) superbly chips the ball over a defender inside the box to feed Isaac Romero in stride, but one of the defenders manages to clear the ball.
52' Jesus Rodriguez (Betis) receives a deflected pass on the edge of the box and smashes the ball at goal. Unfortunately for him, it's well wide of the right post.
52' The ball spins up and hits the hand of Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) after he fails to control it and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
52' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
51' Antony (Betis) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
51' The attendance is 58538.
50' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) passes the ball onto Antony, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
48' Isco (Betis) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
46' Antony (Betis) sends over a cross, but he can't find any teammate inside the box. Poor delivery. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Sevilla.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+5' The end of the first half.
45+4' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Mateo Busquets blows his whistle for a foul.

45+3' 2 - 1 A superb goal from great team play! Cucho Hernandez (Betis) latches on to a perfect pass and fires an excellent shot inside the right post. There is nothing a goalkeeper can do about shots like that.
45+1' Kike Salas (Sevilla) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball has crossed the sideline. Betis are taking a throw-in.
45' There will be a minimum of 3 min. of added time.
45' Kike Salas (Sevilla) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
45' Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) makes a strong challenge and Mateo Busquets blows for a foul.
45' A cross from Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
44' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) takes it short.

43' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. Sevilla have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
43' Mateo Busquets interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Ricardo Rodriguez (Betis).
42' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
39' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) clearly holds his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
37' Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) violates the laws of the game and is shown a deserved yellow card by the referee.
36' Adrian (Betis) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.
33' Jesus Rodriguez (Betis) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
32' Antony (Betis) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
31' Sevilla take a short corner kick.
30' The ball is cleared after Pablo Fornals (Betis) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
29' Poor challenge! Nemanja Gudelj (Sevilla) is penalised for tripping and Mateo Busquets blows his whistle.
27' Dodi Lukebakio (Sevilla) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
25' 1 - 1 Johnny Cardoso (Betis) meets a perfect cross from Youssouf Sabaly deep inside the box, and he produces an accurate strike which goes into the bottom right corner. He makes it 1:1.
24' What a great touch by Antony (Betis) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the bottom right corner, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending.
23' Pablo Fornals (Betis) commits a rough challenge and Mateo Busquets blows his whistle for a foul.
18' 0 - 1 Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) finds himself in a very promising position after getting on the end of a brilliant pass and fires the ball inside the right post!
17' Juanlu Sanchez (Sevilla) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
16' The possession of the ball – 65:35.
13' Isco (Betis) takes the free kick from the edge of the box and fires the ball goalwards. The goalkeeper can stay calm as the shot sails high over the bar.
12' Adria Pedrosa (Sevilla) brings his opponent down. Mateo Busquets has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul. Betis have a free kick from a promising distance.
11' The corner from Isco (Betis) is intercepted by the defence.
11' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
10' Isco (Betis) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
9' Isaac Romero (Sevilla) unleashes a promising shot towards the bottom right corner after his wonderful solo run, but Adrian thwarts the effort with a fabulous save. The score remains the same.
6' Referee Mateo Busquets sees the trip by Jose Angel Carmona (Sevilla) and doesn't hesitate to blow his whistle.
5' Jesus Rodriguez (Betis) takes a snap shot on the edge of the box, but it sails well wide of the right post.
5' Ruben Vargas (Sevilla) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Adrian, who smothers the ball.
3' Cucho Hernandez (Betis) has an effort on goal, but he misses to the right of the goal.
1' The first half has started.
Betis will kick the game off.
